name: CarDA WS30 station (Stellantis Melfi lab line), rebuilt from video
frame: CarDA plant frame from cameras_calibration.xlsx: x along the line WS10 -> WS30 (= belt travel), y across the line towards the IN cameras, z up, floor and belt surface z = 0. Metres, seconds, degrees.
how_measured: Floor positions: real-video pixels projected to z = 0 with the CarDA calibration (both cameras agree within 0.1 m). Heights and object depth: Depth Anything V2 Metric Indoor on a Colab L4, rescaled to the calibrated floor (scale 0.67 to 0.71, floor residual 1 cm median). Worker: Xsens BVH registered to 7 feet picks (residual 0.01 to 0.19 m). Sizes not visible are guesses and say so.
time: t = 0 at the start of CarDA WS30 cycle 003 (mp4 and BVH start together, 54.4 s of mocap).

conveyor.type: floor-flush slat conveyor the worker walks on (guess: skillet or slat 'pedana' conveyor; make unknown)
conveyor.edge_strip: yellow with black teeth, white pitch ticks every 0.3 m on the belt
conveyor.speed_source: robot_consult_demo s1 phase correlation (WS30 23.9 mm/s); castor track in this video gives 22.4 mm/s
conveyor.marks_note: lane lines (pitch 2.93 m), slats and white ticks are on the belt and move with it: x(t) = x(0) + 0.0239 t; lane_lines_x is at t = 0 (seen at 15.12 and 18.05 at t = 1 s)

platform.type: blue anti-slip tread plates, flush with the belt ('PORTATA AL PASSO KG 3000')

carrier.type: door trolley: aluminium strut-profile frame (guess: 45 mm Bosch Rexroth or item profile) on 4 swivel castors, door held upright
carrier.motion: x(t) = 13.093 + 0.0239 t, y and yaw fixed (it rides the belt)
carrier.castor_source: OUT-side castors at plant (13.08, 2.92) and (14.30, 2.92), IN-side castor (14.31, 3.37) at t = 25 s

klt_bins_local.note: downstream shelf, holds the speakers (annotation 1.1 'take the speaker from the cart')

trim_panel_local.note: slanted black panel at the upstream end (likely the door trim panel kit, guess)

door.type: black front door with window frame, inner side facing +y (the worker). Guess: Jeep Renegade or Fiat 500X (Melfi models)

speaker_local.source: worker's hands dwell here during annotation 1.4 'fix 4 screws on the speaker' (t 26 to 50 s)

worker_zone.note: on the belt, IN side of the door, 0.5 to 0.7 m from the door face; rides with the carrier from t = 12 s

line_side_trip.what: takes the screwdriver from the rack (annotation 1.3)

screwdriver_rack.type: white tube-and-joint rack (guess: lean pipe system like Trilogiq or Creform)
screwdriver_rack.tool: cordless pistol screwdriver, orange and black (make unknown, guess Desoutter or Atlas Copco battery tool)

checkerboard_stand.note: hangs just behind the IN camera rod: the OUT camera sees it under the IN camera, the IN camera does not see it

line_side.gantry_beams: blue box beams from each post top towards +x, 3 m (guess: light crane runway such as Demag KBK)

cameras: cameras_ws30.json (ZED 2, 1280x720 left image, on 1.85 m rods): IN (16.09, 5.44, 1.80) looking -y, OUT (15.92, 0.30, 1.80) looking +y

automation_anchors_proposed.note: Not in the video; suggested for the automated version so arms stay off the worker lane and the belt.

humanoid_stand_out_side.note: belt, OUT side of the trolley; reaches the door's outer skin only
